info.title: The panel vocabulary: families, widgets, display kinds, display sources and placements of a panel

PANEL_FAMILIES.description: The panel families of a plugin (omx-panel docs/panel-layout.md): the kind of processor its panel is laid out for. The words and their order are the contract; omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs FAMILIES and the skin package schema read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_FAMILIES.x-why: Panel families and widgets are declarations, so they live here (vocabulary-owner rule, FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

oneOf.title: none
oneOf.description: a plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and roles
oneOf.x-text: A plugin with no family: its panel is laid out from its groups and its roles.

oneOf.title: gate
oneOf.x-text: A gate's or an expander's panel family.

oneOf.title: dynamics
oneOf.x-text: A compressor's panel family.

oneOf.title: limiter
oneOf.x-text: A limiter's panel family.

oneOf.title: deesser
oneOf.x-text: A de-esser's panel family.

oneOf.title: eq
oneOf.x-text: An equaliser's panel family, parametric or graphic.

oneOf.title: filter
oneOf.x-text: A filter's panel family.

oneOf.title: drive
oneOf.x-text: A saturator's or a distortion's panel family.

oneOf.title: modulation
oneOf.description: a chorus, flanger, phaser or tremolo
oneOf.x-text: A chorus's, a flanger's, a phaser's or a tremolo's panel family.

oneOf.title: delay
oneOf.x-text: A delay's panel family.

oneOf.title: reverb
oneOf.x-text: A reverb's panel family.

oneOf.title: pitch
oneOf.x-text: A pitch shifter's panel family.

oneOf.title: utility
oneOf.description: a gain trim, a stereo width control or another utility that shapes a signal without a processor's character
oneOf.x-text: A utility's panel family: a trim, a width control, a balancer or a clipper.

PANEL_STANDARD_WIDGETS.description: The standard widgets a panel picks from a descriptor and a representation (a skin) draws, in the order omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs STANDARD_WIDGETS lists them.

oneOf.title: knob
oneOf.x-text: A travel, drawn as a knob.

oneOf.title: fader
oneOf.x-text: A travel drawn long, as a fader.

oneOf.title: switch
oneOf.x-text: A toggle, drawn as a switch.

oneOf.title: selector
oneOf.description: an integer travel or labelled values
oneOf.x-text: An integer travel or labelled values, drawn as a selector.

oneOf.title: meter
oneOf.x-text: A readout, drawn as a meter.

oneOf.title: curve
oneOf.x-text: A response or transfer curve, drawn as a graph.

oneOf.title: xy
oneOf.description: two controls drawn as one point
oneOf.x-text: Two controls drawn together as one point on a plane.

oneOf.title: display
oneOf.x-text: A value shown as text.

PANEL_WIDGETS.description: The widgets a declared panel may name for a control, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1): auto leaves the choice to the panel layout. The four others are the shared widgets of omx-panel's schema/panel.schema.json.

oneOf.title: auto
oneOf.description: left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control
oneOf.x-text: Left out of a panel declaration: the layout picks the widget from the control.

oneOf.title: knob
oneOf.x-text: A rotary control.

oneOf.title: fader
oneOf.x-text: A linear control.

oneOf.title: switch
oneOf.x-text: A two-state control.

oneOf.title: selector
oneOf.description: a control that picks one of a few values
oneOf.x-text: A control that picks one of a few values.

PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.description: The displays a declared panel may carry, and the extension serves (org.openmixer.panel-description/1), in the order of their codes: a panel description names a display by its place here. omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_KINDS.x-why: omx-clap-core restated these words by hand beside the families and widgets; a display kind is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

oneOf.title: gainReductionBar
oneOf.description: a bar of the gain a dynamics processor takes off
oneOf.x-text: A bar showing the gain reduction.

oneOf.title: transferCurve
oneOf.description: a dynamics processor's output level against its input level
oneOf.x-text: The dynamics transfer curve: output level against input level.

oneOf.title: eqResponse
oneOf.x-text: The equaliser's frequency response.

oneOf.title: meter
oneOf.x-text: A level meter.

oneOf.title: timeResponse
oneOf.description: a response over time: a delay's train of taps or a reverb's decay envelope
oneOf.x-text: The response over time: a delay's taps or a reverb's decay.

PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.description: Where a panel description's display takes its data from, in the order of their codes (org.openmixer.panel-description/1). omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_DISPLAY_SOURCES.x-why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand beside the families, widgets and display kinds; a display source is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

oneOf.title: family
oneOf.description: the data the panel family itself implies
oneOf.x-text: The data the panel family implies.

oneOf.title: meters
oneOf.x-text: The plugin's meter readouts.

oneOf.title: gainAdjustment
oneOf.x-text: The gain the processor applies.

oneOf.title: curve
oneOf.x-text: A curve the plugin declares.

PANEL_PLACEMENTS.description: Where an instance sits, in the order of their codes: the clap.track-info/1 flags read as one value (org.openmixer.panel-description/1). omx-panel's tools/panel-description.mjs and omx-clap-core's panel tables read them, and keep their code.
PANEL_PLACEMENTS.x-why: omx-clap-core and omx-plugins restated these words by hand; a placement is a declaration, so it lives here (vocabulary-owner rule).

oneOf.title: insert
oneOf.description: an instance on a track's insert chain
oneOf.x-text: An instance on an insert chain.

oneOf.title: return
oneOf.description: an instance on a return track

oneOf.title: bus
oneOf.x-text: An instance on a bus.
